(2) A subtle 'whoosh' SFX plays as scenes transition. The BGM remains constant as the narrator recounts a past rental issue. (3) A 'ding' SFX coincides with the appearance of the SkyHorse logo. Ambient noise from the airport is barely audible under the music. (4) The music transitions to a slightly more rhythmic pop track as driving scenes begin. The low hum of the Tesla's electric motor is masked by the music. (5) Fast 'pop' SFX are triggered as variety subtitles appear. Laughter and splashing sounds from the water park montage are mixed into the BGM. (6) The male speaker concludes with an enthusiastic tone, supported by a final drum hit and a quick fade of the acoustic music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Comparison -> Problem -> Solution -> Experience -> Brand Advocacy.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a travel vlog and promotional endorsement for SkyHorse car rental. It uses a hook describing a past bad experience with Turo to introduce SkyHorse as a superior, reliable alternative for Taiwanese travelers in the US, highlighting the Tesla FSD feature and Mandarin-speaking customer service.
